page_title: PAR 1-1 EMP | Parma v Empoli 27/10/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' Federico La Penna is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+4' It must be a yellow card. It is. Simon Sohm (Parma) receives the caution after an awful tackle.
90+1' Pietro Pellegri (Empoli) goes into the book for a horrible tackle. A yellow card is necessary in this case.
90+1' Botond Balogh (Parma) has tested the patience of referee Federico La Penna and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.
90' It will be a corner kick for Parma.
87' We are about to witness a subsitution. Emmanuel Ekong (Empoli) for Ola Solbakken.
87' 14:6 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
84' Here is a change. Adrian Bernabe Garcia is going off and Fabio Pecchia gives the last tactical orders to Valentin Mihaila (Parma).
84' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Ange-Yoan Bonny walks off the pitch to be replaced by Drissa Camara (Parma).
84' Ange-Yoan Bonny (Parma) fails to score from the penalty spot! His effort only crashes against the crossbar.
83' Ange-Yoan Bonny (Parma) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
82' Devis Stiven Vasquez Llach (Empoli) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Federico La Penna had an easy-decision to make.
82' A clumsy foul by Devis Stiven Vasquez Llach (Empoli) and Federico La Penna blows his whistle. The referee gives a penalty to Parma!

80' 1 - 1 Goal! A terrific long pass from Emanuele Valeri picks out an unmarked Gabriel Charpentier (Parma) inside the box. He has time and space to pick his spot and slams the ball low into the middle of the goal. 1:1.
80' Roberto D'Aversa has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Nicolas Haas (Empoli) replacing Jacopo Fazzini.
80' Substitution. Youssef Maleh (Empoli) in, Alberto Grassi out.
77' A spell of possession for Parma in an attempt to control the game.
73' Let's have a look at statistics for the fouls committed by both teams – 10:12.
71' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Alberto Grassi (Empoli) was quite harsh and Federico La Penna didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
69' Roberto D'Aversa has decided to substitute Lorenzo Colombo and he is replaced by Pietro Pellegri (Empoli).
69' Substitution. Faustino Anjorin is replaced by Liam Henderson (Empoli).
67' Ardian Ismajli (Empoli) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Federico La Penna had an easy-decision to make.
67' Ange-Yoan Bonny (Parma) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
64' Some great controlled play and passing from Parma. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
60' Ball possession – 55:45.
58' Mandela Keita (Parma) gets the ball and drives a shot high over the bar from the edge of the area.
57' Parma work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
55' Fabio Pecchia decides to make a substitution. Matteo Cancellieri will be replaced by Pontus Almqvist (Parma).
55' Substitution. Hernani leaves the pitch and is replaced by Mandela Keita (Parma).
54' Parma have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
54' Parma take a short corner kick.
53' Gabriel Charpentier (Parma) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
50' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Hernani (Parma) was quite harsh and Federico La Penna didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
49' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Empoli.
48' Ola Solbakken (Empoli) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The ball goes out for a corner. Empoli can continue in their attacking effort.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Fabio Pecchia probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Dennis Man (Parma). He is replaced by Gabriel Charpentier.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+2' The end of the first half.
45' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Ange-Yoan Bonny (Parma) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Federico La Penna has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
42' Parma are bossing possession of the ball and make numerous short passes, but they finally lose possession after an error.
40' Emmanuel Gyasi (Empoli) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked.
39' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 4:4.
38' Jacopo Fazzini (Empoli) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
38' A quickly taken corner by Parma.
35' 0 - 1 Here is an example of luck not being on your side. A slightly disorientated Woyo Coulibaly (Parma) puts the ball into his own net.
32' Parma take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
29' Jacopo Fazzini (Empoli) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
28' Parma quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
24' Some great play by Jacopo Fazzini (Empoli) ends with a shot on the edge of the box low towards the middle of the net, but Zion Suzuki sees it all the way and makes a comfortable save.
22' The ratio of the ball possession is 45:55.
20' Faustino Anjorin (Empoli) has tested the patience of referee Federico La Penna and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
17' Alberto Grassi (Empoli) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.
16' Federico La Penna shows a yellow card to Enrico Del Prato (Parma) for his blatant foul.
13' Empoli are seeing far more of the ball now.
10' Alberto Grassi (Empoli) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
9' Hernani (Parma) fails to deliver a decent cross from the corner and the ball goes out of play.
7' Federico La Penna blows his whistle for a foul after Hernani (Parma) hacks down one of his opponents.
5' The corner is swung in but Empoli can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
5' Jacopo Fazzini (Empoli) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
3' Parma force a corner. They send men into the box.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Empoli will have the kick-off.
Federico La Penna will officiate today.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
